decision_history.new_value: 2EFT is a genuine irreversible-inhibition experiment with parent inhibitor MeSSCoA, but the retained covalent component MEE is only the methanethiol/methyl-disulfide fragment while the CoA recognition body is separate. It therefore does not represent a complete pocket-conditioned covalent ligand for CovaPIE V1 and is excluded from the positive dataset while preserved as mechanistic evidence.

1GSN is a genuine high-quality biochemical covalent structure: the real Cys58–SSG linkage is Cys58 glutathionylation/mixed-disulfide chemistry arising in oxidative inactivation by physiological NO carriers and glutathione/redox chemistry. GSH is an endogenous tripeptide redox metabolite/substrate, not a designed medicinal pocket-binding covalent inhibitor, so the unit is scientifically valuable but outside the positive CovaPIE V1 protein-pocket-conditioned ligand-generation domain; preserve it as frozen mechanistic/redox evidence, not a positive V1 sample.

1BWC is a genuine Cys58 mixed-disulfide structure of ajoene, a covalent inhibitor and subversive substrate. Deposited AJ3 is not full 13-heavy-atom ajoene, but unlike the trivial 2EFT/MEE fragment it is the documented retained product moiety: a substantial 9-heavy-atom framework containing unsaturated chains, sulfoxide functionality, and the reactive sulfur. The four absent heavy atoms belong to the disulfide leaving-group side rather than a separately deposited major recognition scaffold, so the unit is relevant to CovaPIE post-only V1. Leaving-group-loss precursor-completeness and final warhead/role supervision semantics remain unresolved, therefore chemistry and event decisions stay blank and the workflow remains IN_PROGRESS.

Human review accepts 2AX0/5X as a high-value CovaPIE post-only V1 example: primary literature establishes a selective, allosteric, sub-micromolar reversible-covalent HCV NS5B inhibitor series, and the experimental adduct retains the complete 27-heavy-atom 5X ligand. The historical Acrylamide source label is broad and nonliteral and is not used as exact chemistry authority.

Human review confirms C1 as the reversible covalent electrophilic endpoint, classifies the chemistry as rhodanine-associated exocyclic-alkene Cys-SG conjugate addition rather than literal acrylamide, uses WA as the complete exact-one-boundary role-level reactive region, and selects Partition B with an N-sulfonyl linker and benzenesulfonyl recognition scaffold.

decision_history.new_value: Human negative calibration for 2AAZ/UMP: the deposited component is natural dUMP in the normal thymidylate-synthase catalytic substrate/intermediate state. This is a genuine and structurally useful biochemical covalent state, but dUMP is not a designed medicinal pocket-recognition covalent ligand for CovaPIE post-only V1. This decision is exact to this unit and does not cover UFP/FdUMP, other nucleotides, or other thymidylate-synthase ligands.

Human negative calibration for 1FVG/DTT-S4: DTT is dithiothreitol, a reducing reagent present as an actual small-molecule ligand in the frozen biochemical and crystallization context, and the same DTT instance participates through its two sulfur ends. The Cys218-SG to DTT-S4 state is reducing-reagent or biochemical-artifact chemistry rather than a medicinal pocket-recognition covalent ligand. This decision is exact to this unit and does not decide DTT-S1, DTU, AJ3, or thiols and disulfides generally.

Human negative calibration for 1CR5+1RP4/NEN: NEN is the deposited N-ethylmaleimide-derived covalent product; the frozen experimental context includes NEM modification before crystallization, and the same small reactive graph occurs across unrelated proteins and multiple Cys sites. This supports generic cysteine-modifier chemistry rather than a target-specific medicinal pocket-recognition ligand. Source modifier/Acrylamide is supporting evidence only and is not a rule; committed 5X remains the counterexample to using that broad source label as chemistry truth.

Human negative calibration for 1PY0/YMA-S1: 1PY0 is engineered E51C/E54C pseudoazurin with the bidentate CLaNP probe, whose primary purpose is a paramagnetic shift agent for protein NMR. YMA attaches through two thiol-reactive ends to two engineered surface-exposed Cys residues, so this is structural or NMR labeling rather than inhibition or medicinal pocket recognition. This exact decision does not generalize probe to negative and does not decide MHC or the YMA-S2 sibling.

Human negative calibration for 1XD3/GVE: the frozen UCH-L3-UbVME structure contains UCH-L3 Cys95-SG to GVE-CB and an explicit second connection from ubiquitin-polymer Gly75-C to GVE-N. GVE is therefore a small reactive adapter connecting the target enzyme to the ubiquitin recognition polymer; the major recognition body is outside the retained small component, so this is not an independently complete medicinal pocket-recognition covalent ligand. This decision does not generalize from 8 heavy atoms, ringless topology, or an inhibitor label, and AJ3 remains the committed counterexample.
